summary:
Main
The sanctions package that landed last week barely had time to settle before the shooting resumed. strikes and Iranian retaliation ended the recent lull, while commercial traffic through Hormuz again ran below pre-conflict levels. For Gulf-positioned recycling candidates, the immediate risk has shifted back from sanctions paperwork to passage, insurance and physical security.
